pr.title: Optimize header layout performance with flexbox mixins

raw_findings.body: `-ms-align-items` was never implemented by any browser (IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align`, which is already emitted on the previous line), so every use of the mixin ships a dead, invalid declaration that bloats output and misleads maintainers into thinking IE coverage comes from this line.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Invalid CSS declaration is emitted on every mixin use and silently ignored by all browsers.
raw_findings.impact: `-ms-align-items` was never implemented by any browser (IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align`, which is already emitted on the previous line), so every use of the mixin ships a dead, invalid declaration that bloats output and misleads maintainers into thinking IE coverage comes from this line.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new mixin includes a fabricated Microsoft-prefixed property alongside the real `-ms-flex-align` prefix.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Delete the `-ms-align-items: $alignment;` line; `-ms-flex-align` already covers the IE10 syntax.
raw_findings.title: Nonexistent `-ms-align-items` property emitted by new align-items mixin
raw_findings.trigger: Any stylesheet that calls `@include align-items(...)` (header.scss, topic-post.scss, badges.css.scss) compiles this declaration into the shipped CSS.

raw_findings.body: Floats are ignored on children of a flex container, so the button loses its right-edge alignment and renders inline immediately after `.small-action-desc`, visually regressing the small-action row layout.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Silent visual regression: descendant float rule becomes a no-op under the new layout mode.
raw_findings.impact: Floats are ignored on children of a flex container, so the button loses its right-edge alignment and renders inline immediately after `.small-action-desc`, visually regressing the small-action row layout.
raw_findings.root_cause: The patch converts `.small-action` to a flex container without updating the pre-existing float-based positioning of its `button` child.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Give the button `margin-left: auto;` (plus old-box/order fallbacks consistent with the new mixins) instead of relying on the now-inert `float: right`.
raw_findings.title: Flex container on .small-action neutralizes existing `button { float: right; }` alignment
raw_findings.trigger: Rendering a small-action post (topic status update) that includes its action button; the unchanged rule `.small-action button { float: right; }` at R309 now applies to a flex item.

raw_findings.body: With the left padding shrunk from `4em` (~56px) to `1.5%`, the untouched `-40px` negative margin now pulls the custom message ~40px past the description's left edge, overlapping the avatar or clipping on mobile.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Cross-file coupling breaks: an unchanged compensating rule now over-corrects, producing misaligned/overlapping mobile layout.
raw_findings.impact: With the left padding shrunk from `4em` (~56px) to `1.5%`, the untouched `-40px` negative margin now pulls the custom message ~40px past the description's left edge, overlapping the avatar or clipping on mobile.
raw_findings.root_cause: The padding value the mobile negative-margin hack depended on was changed without adjusting the dependent mobile rule.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Update or remove the mobile `margin-left: -40px` override in mobile/topic-post.scss in the same change, or restore a fixed left padding it can offset.
raw_findings.title: Reduced .small-action-desc left padding breaks mobile `.custom-message { margin-left: -40px }` compensation
raw_findings.trigger: Viewing a small-action with a custom message on mobile, where mobile/topic-post.scss:521 applies `.small-action .small-action-desc .custom-message { margin-left: -40px; }` to offset the old `4em` left padding.

raw_findings.body: The old box model does not distribute free space via auto margins, and the patch also removed `float: right` from `.panel` (L37), so on those browsers the header panel (icons/login buttons) collapses to the left next to the title instead of being pushed to the right edge.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Inconsistent compatibility contract: vendor-prefixed fallbacks are shipped, but the layout depends on a feature those fallbacks cannot honor.
raw_findings.impact: The old box model does not distribute free space via auto margins, and the patch also removed `float: right` from `.panel` (L37), so on those browsers the header panel (icons/login buttons) collapses to the left next to the title instead of being pushed to the right edge.
raw_findings.root_cause: The right-alignment technique (`margin-left: auto`) is only valid in the modern flexbox spec, while the patch's own mixins advertise support for the 2009 box-model syntax where it does nothing.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Either keep a `float: right` fallback for `.panel`, insert a `box-flex: 1` spacer for old-box syntax, or drop the 2009-syntax prefixes from the mixins if those browsers are unsupported.
raw_findings.title: `margin-left: auto` on .panel has no effect in the legacy box-model fallbacks the new mixins target
raw_findings.trigger: Loading the header in browsers that only support the 2009 flexbox syntax (`display: -webkit-box` / `-moz-box`, e.g. Android stock browser ≤4.3, Firefox <20), which the new flexbox mixin explicitly emits fallbacks for.

raw_findings.body: The `align-items` mixin uses 4-space indentation, omits the space after the colon on `align-items:$alignment;`, and R120 carries trailing whitespace, producing inconsistent style within the same new code block that will trip SCSS linters and future diffs.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Maintainability/lint noise: inconsistent formatting inside newly introduced code.
raw_findings.impact: The `align-items` mixin uses 4-space indentation, omits the space after the colon on `align-items:$alignment;`, and R120 carries trailing whitespace, producing inconsistent style within the same new code block that will trip SCSS linters and future diffs.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new mixin was pasted with formatting inconsistent with the surrounding file and the other mixins added in the same patch.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Reindent the mixin body to 2 spaces, add a space after the colon (`align-items: $alignment;`), and strip the trailing whitespace on the `-ms-flex-align` line.
raw_findings.title: align-items mixin body violates file formatting conventions (4-space indent, missing space after colon, trailing whitespace)
raw_findings.trigger: Any developer reading or linting mixins.scss; the sibling `flexbox()` and `order()` mixins added in the same patch use 2-space indentation and `property: value` spacing.
